error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This is a fault on our side, not yours. Try again. If it keeps happening, tell us the code below.
error.help: Quote this code if you ask for help

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page may have moved.

sessionExpired.title: You've been signed out
sessionExpired.body: For your safety, we sign you out after a while. Sign in again to carry on.
sessionExpired.note: Anything you saved is still here.

dashboard.title: Nothing sold yet today
dashboard.body: Sales from your counter and website show up here.

activity.title: No activity yet
activity.body: Sign-ins, scans, refunds and changes are listed here.

calendar.title: No bookings on this day
calendar.body: Bookings from the counter and website appear on the calendar.

orders.title: No orders yet
orders.body: Sales from the counter and your website appear here.

orders-detail.title: Nothing to show for this order
orders-detail.body: No items or payments are recorded on it yet.

issued-orders.title: No tickets issued yet
issued-orders.body: Every ticket you sell is listed here with its code and status.

ticket-detail.title: This ticket hasn't been used
ticket-detail.body: Gate scans and code changes will show here.

customers.title: No customers yet
customers.body: Add a name and phone to a sale and the customer is saved here.

customers-detail.title: No bookings yet
customers-detail.body: This customer's bookings and notes will show here.

catalog.title: Nothing for sale yet
catalog.body: Add a ticket, tour, court or event. It shows at the counter once it's on sale.

catalog-new.title: Nothing matches that
catalog-new.body: Try another word, like tour, court or concert.

catalog-new-booking.title: Start your booking
catalog-new-booking.body: A name and a price are enough. You can change the rest later.

catalog-new-event.title: Start your event
catalog-new-event.body: Add a name, a date and a ticket price to put it on sale.

catalog-booking.title: No sales yet
catalog-booking.body: Sales and bookings for this item will show here.

catalog-event.title: No tickets sold yet
catalog-event.body: Ticket sales for this event show here once it's on sale.

catalog-event-edit.title: Add the basics first
catalog-event-edit.body: A name, a date and a ticket price are enough to start.

catalog-layouts.title: No seat maps yet
catalog-layouts.body: Draw a hall or dining room once, then sell seats or tables from it.

catalog-layout.title: This seat map is empty
catalog-layout.body: Pick seats or tables on the left, then tap the plan to place them.

inventory.title: No stock yet
inventory.body: Add things you hand over or sell, like bottles, bags or hire shoes.

inventory-new.title: Add your first stock item
inventory-new.body: Give it a name and a price. You can count it in after.

inventory-detail.title: No stock changes yet
inventory-detail.body: Deliveries, sales and counts are listed here.

marketplaces.title: No other sites connected
marketplaces.body: List your tickets on other websites and see every booking in one place.

marketplace-detail.title: Nothing listed here yet
marketplace-detail.body: Choose which bookings to show on this site.

analytics.title: No sales in this period
analytics.body: Pick a longer date range, or open the counter to make a sale.

finances.title: No money moved yet
finances.body: Payments, fees and payouts show here once you start selling.

expenses.title: No expenses yet
expenses.body: Write down what you spend, like supplies or repairs.

memberships.title: No members yet
memberships.body: Sell a membership and your members will be listed here.

pricing.title: No price rules yet
pricing.body: Set a different price for busy days or times.

pricing-detail.title: Set up this price rule
pricing-detail.body: Choose the bookings, the days and the new price.

promotions.title: No promotions yet
promotions.body: Create a discount or code to bring customers back.

promotion-detail.title: Set up this promotion
promotion-detail.body: Choose the discount and who can use it.

booking-rules.title: No booking rules yet
booking-rules.body: Add rules for how far ahead, how late and how many.

booking-rule-detail.title: Set up this rule
booking-rule-detail.body: Choose which bookings it covers and the limit.

settings-business.title: Tell us about your business
settings-business.body: Add your name, currency and time zone to get started.

settings-counters.title: No counters yet
settings-counters.body: A counter is a place where you sell, like a front desk or gate.

settings-counter-new.title: Add your first counter
settings-counter-new.body: Give it a name and say which venue it belongs to.

settings-counter.title: This counter isn't set up
settings-counter.body: Choose what it sells and how it takes payment.

settings-devices.title: No tablets paired yet
settings-devices.body: Pair a tablet and choose who can sign in on it.

settings-device-new.title: Pair your first tablet
settings-device-new.body: You'll get a short code to type on the tablet.

settings-device.title: This device isn't set up
settings-device.body: Pick its counter and the people who can use it.

settings-locations.title: No venues yet
settings-locations.body: Add the place where you sell, with its address and hours.

settings-location-new.title: Add your first venue
settings-location-new.body: Start with a name and an address.

settings-location.title: This venue isn't set up
settings-location.body: Add its address and opening hours.

settings-loyalty.title: Points are switched off
settings-loyalty.body: Turn on points so customers earn rewards when they buy.

settings-memberships.title: No membership plans yet
settings-memberships.body: Create a plan, like monthly or yearly, with a price and perks.

settings-notifications.title: No messages set up
settings-notifications.body: Choose which messages customers and staff receive.

settings-payments.title: No payment accounts yet
settings-payments.body: Connect bKash or a card account to take payments online.

settings-preferences.title: Nothing chosen yet
settings-preferences.body: Pick how it looks and which language to use in this browser.

settings-privacy.title: No privacy policy yet
settings-privacy.body: Add one so customers know how you use their details.

settings-profile.title: Your profile is empty
settings-profile.body: Add your name and phone so your team knows who you are.

settings-resources.title: No courts, lanes or rooms yet
settings-resources.body: Add what customers book, like a court, a lane or a room.

settings-resource-new.title: Add your first one
settings-resource-new.body: Give it a name and a price per hour.

settings-resource.title: This one isn't set up
settings-resource.body: Add its name, its price and when it is free.

settings-roles.title: No roles yet
settings-roles.body: A role says what a team member can do.

settings-role-new.title: Create your first role
settings-role-new.body: Name it, then tick what people in this role can do.

settings-role.title: This role isn't set up
settings-role.body: Tick what people in this role can do.

settings-security.title: Your account isn't protected yet
settings-security.body: Add a strong password and turn on two-step sign-in.

settings-sign-in.title: No sign-in rules yet
settings-sign-in.body: Choose how long people stay signed in and when the counter locks.

settings-storefront.title: No web pages yet
settings-storefront.body: A web page lets customers see and book your tickets online.

settings-storefront-detail.title: This page isn't set up
settings-storefront-detail.body: Add a headline, a colour and what to show.

settings-tax.title: No tax rates yet
settings-tax.body: Set your VAT rate so prices and receipts add up.

settings-team.title: No team members yet
settings-team.body: Invite your staff so they can sign in and sell.

settings-team-new.title: Invite your first team member
settings-team-new.body: Add their name and choose what they can do.

settings-team-member.title: This person isn't set up
settings-team-member.body: Choose their role, their venues and a counter PIN.

settings-tickets.title: No ticket code settings
settings-tickets.body: Choose how tickets are scanned and what is printed.

settings-vat.title: VAT isn't set up
settings-vat.body: Add your VAT number and how often you file returns.

generic.title: Nothing here yet
generic.body: When there is something to show, it will appear here.

go-sell.title: Nothing to sell yet
go-sell.body: Things for sale at this counter will show here.

go-sell-scroll.title: Nothing to sell yet
go-sell-scroll.body: Things for sale at this counter will show here.

go-classic.title: Nothing to sell yet
go-classic.body: Things for sale at this counter will show here.

go-cart.title: The sale is empty
go-cart.body: Pick something on the Sell screen to add it here.

go-complete.title: No sale to show
go-complete.body: When a sale is done, its tickets show here.

go-sell-complete.title: No sale to show
go-sell-complete.body: When a sale is done, its tickets show here.

go-classic-complete.title: No sale to show
go-classic-complete.body: When a sale is done, its tickets show here.

go-schedule.title: Nothing booked yet
go-schedule.body: Bookings for this day will show here.

go-checkin.title: No guests to check in
go-checkin.body: Guests with a booking for this day will show here.

go-reservations.title: No bookings yet
go-reservations.body: Bookings made at the counter will show here.

go-my-sales.title: No sales yet
go-my-sales.body: Your sales for today will show here.

go-scan.title: Ready to scan
go-scan.body: Scan a ticket and the answer will show here.

go-quick-pass.title: No passes to give
go-quick-pass.body: Ask your manager to set up a pass first.

go-profile.title: No profile to show
go-profile.body: Sign in to see your details.

go-till-settings.title: No settings here yet
go-till-settings.body: Settings for this device will show here.

go-shift-open.title: Start your shift
go-shift-open.body: Count the cash in the drawer, then press start.

go-shift-close.title: Close your shift
go-shift-close.body: Count the cash in the drawer to finish for today.

go-login.title: No one to sign in
go-login.body: Ask your manager to add you to this counter.

go-pair.title: No tablet paired yet
go-pair.body: Type the code your manager gave you.
